name: What is the process for selecting a project manager for a multi-family development?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for selecting a project manager for a multi-family development?

acceptedAnswer.text: Selecting a project manager for a multi-family development involves evaluating their experience, expertise, and track record with similar projects. Begin by reviewing their portfolio, focusing on completed multi-family residential developments, especially those comparable in size and scope to your project. Assess their communication style, problem-solving skills, and knowledge of local regulations and construction practices. Request references and conduct interviews to ensure alignment with your project goals and company culture. A clear understanding of their proposed project management methodology is also vital.
acceptedAnswer.description: Select a multi-family project manager by evaluating their experience with similar projects, reviewing their portfolio, and assessing communication and problem-solving skills. Request references and ensure their methodology aligns with your goals.
